name: File Storage (Garage)
description: S3-compatible file storage on your own machine: upload, organize and share files through Crow
author: Crow

env_vars.name: GARAGE_BIND_ADDR
env_vars.description: Host IP the S3 port (3900) listens on. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only). Set it to this host's tailnet IP to share storage with paired Crow instances, and set S3_ENDPOINT to the same address. Never 0.0.0.0 on a host without a firewall.

env_vars.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env_vars.description: Where Crow reaches this storage: host:port of the S3 API. Use the same host as GARAGE_BIND_ADDR.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_DATA_PATH
env_vars.description: Optional folder for the stored files, on a local disk (not a network or USB-FUSE mount). Leave empty to keep them in a Docker volume.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_RPC_SECRET
env_vars.description: Internal secret between Garage's own processes. Crow generates it and saves it in Settings → Passwords.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Full-control admin token for Garage. Crow generates it and saves it in Settings → Passwords. It stays in this extension's own settings: never copied to Crow's gateway or to other extensions.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_METRICS_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Token for Garage's metrics endpoint. Crow generates it and saves it in Settings → Passwords.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_KEY
env_vars.description: Access key ID of the S3 key Crow uses. Crow generates it, saves it in Settings → Passwords and shares it with Crow storage as S3_ACCESS_KEY.

env_vars.name: GARAGE_DEFAULT_SECRET_KEY
env_vars.description: Secret of the S3 key Crow uses. Crow generates it, saves it in Settings → Passwords and shares it with Crow storage as S3_SECRET_KEY.

notes: After installation, Crow's storage tools (upload, list, delete files) use this storage automatically. There is no web console: browse files in Crow's Files page. The S3 API listens on port 3900; the admin API on 127.0.0.1:3903 only.
